ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass — computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow, validateHandlerOrder does not check for zero
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: validateHandlerOrder checks bounds.isSet && sqrtPriceX96 < bounds.minSqrtPriceX96. If bounds are configured with minSqrtPriceX96 > 0, zero price is caught. If bounds are NOT configured (isSet=false), there are no bounds to bypass. Halmos symbolic check (check_noPricingBypass) passed with 26 paths. No extraction path exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call — calling CLOBTransferHandler directly bypasses pricing enforcement
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler has no executeSwap function. The only settlement entry point is ammHandleTransfer which checks msg.sender == AMM at line 230. Direct calls revert with CLOBTransferHandler__CallbackMustBeFromAMM. Test test_KV2_directHandlerCall_blocked and test_C2_clobHandler_ammHandleTransfer_reverts_nonAMM both confirm the guard holds.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap — setTokenSettings may desync initialized field between registry and hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Registry stores initialized=true in memSettings but passes raw settings to hook. Hook stores with initialized=false. However, _getOrFetchTokenSettings (line 907-918) auto-corrects: if initialized==false, it fetches from registry (which has initialized=true). Self-healing pattern. No value extraction path — only extra gas cost. Known as CP-005.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak — DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT not cleared on all paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds writes to DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT in beforeSwap for direct swaps (poolType==address(0)), reads in afterSwap. Slot overwritten by next beforeSwap call. Transient storage resets per tx. Cross-tx leak impossible. Same-tx: AMM always calls before then after in sequence. Known CP-001/CP-004. No new exploitation path beyond documented low severity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Forge permit with arbitrary feeOnTop → drain extra tokens
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop is unsigned but bounded by limitAmount (signed). Input swap: feeOnTop > amountIn reverts (FeeHelper:53). Output swap: feeOnTop added to amountIn, AMMModule:2171 checks amountIn > limitAmount → reverts. Signer exposure always bounded.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Spoof executor context → settle orders with wrong recipient
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Both handlers require msg.sender == AMM. Executor derived from msg.sender in AMMModule swap flow. Cannot be spoofed from external caller.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Replay CLOB order with different nonce context
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOB orders use auto-incremented nonces (nextOrderNonce++). Each order gets unique nonce. closeOrder checks maker ownership. No replay mechanism.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: Redirect fee to attacker address via hook configuration
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fee configuration requires token owner/admin. Fee recipients in swaps don't affect signer exposure because limitAmount bounds total cost.
EIP-712 domain separator includes chainId. PermitC constructs domain separator with chainId. Different chains produce different digests. Same signature invalid on another chain.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: ERC-1271 contract returns true for any hash → bypass signature checks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ERC-1271 contract can only sign for ITSELF. PermitC verifies signature against the from address. Attacker's ERC-1271 contract can only authorize spending its own tokens.
AMM calls back to msg.sender.onFlashLoan(). No separate callback registration. Cannot impersonate another address as the callback target. Balance check enforced after callback.
Neither handler uses tx.origin. All access control uses msg.sender. No tx.origin phishing vector.
All module-crossing calls go through diamond proxy with delegatecall (preserves msg.sender). External calls to handlers check msg.sender == AMM. No way to forge msg.sender in EVM.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H10: Reuse permit signature with different from address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: The from address is part of the EIP-712 signed data. Changing from invalidates the signature digest. Cannot drain another user's tokens with a different user's signature.
